Mardenholde Keep is the imposing stone citadel overlooking Hearthglen in the northern reaches of the Western Plaguelands. Once the ancestral seat of Highlord Tirion Fordring, it now serves as the regional command center for the fanatical Scarlet Crusade under the rule of his son, Highlord Taelan Fordring.

Built as the administrative heart of the Hearthglen principality, Mardenholde Keep was long celebrated by the people of Lordaeron for having never breached during the Second War. From its council chambers, Highlord Tirion Fordring governed the surrounding vales alongside his trusted advisors, maintaining peace until his controversial trial and exile for defending the orc Eitrigg. Following Tirion's fall, governance fell to his ambitious apprentice Barthilas and eventually passed to Tirion's son, Taelan, who inherited his father's domain on the eve of Lordaeron's destruction.

When the Scourge swept through Lordaeron, Taelan opened Mardenholde to surviving commanders of the Knights of the Silver Hand, including Alexandros Mograine and Saidan Dathrohan. Within these halls, the remnants of the order plotted their resistance against the undead. However, internal paranoia and dark subversion soon fractured their fellowship. When accusations of treachery surfaced following Mograine's demise, Maxwell Tyrosus broke away to found the Argent Dawn, while Dathrohan and the remaining zealots reorganized Hearthglen into a fortified bastion of the newly minted Scarlet Crusade.

Both Alliance and Horde naturalists, including tauren emissaries and gnomish tinkers, share the crowded ledge alongside the surviving Marshal crew.
